regression_gate: pending: M7 owns evaluation and promotion

schema.action: a = clip(a_base + r, -1, 1); ctrl = default_pose + 0.5 a

parameters.name: roll_from_roll
parameters.doc: gravity_y deviation -> roll basis (left legs extend)

parameters.name: pitch_from_pitch
parameters.doc: gravity_x deviation -> pitch basis (front legs extend)

parameters.name: deadzone_margin
parameters.doc: activation starts at 1 + margin calibrated half-widths

bases.shift: +1 on every hip: feet move toward +y (left)
bases.roll: left legs extend, right legs shorten
bases.pitch: front legs extend, rear legs shorten

source.method: median and largest absolute deviation from it, per signal, over all Ticks of base-policy episodes without pushes

sets.name: hardening-sets-v1

locked_test.status: reserved for M7; not evaluated in M6

notes: Confirmed failures were recorded as baseline falls by M2-M5 on the fall-contact scene; every M6 run re-measures the baseline.

Training push starts lie at gait phases 42-68 substeps (of 110); validation-preview phases are 14-40 and 84. Timings at the same phase of the 0.44 s gait are strongly correlated, so different timestamps are not independent tests.
Training variants are seeded perturbations (force +-10%, direction +-10 deg, start +-4 and duration +-3 substeps) and are not confirmed failures.
The locked test set is for M7 and is refused by all M6 evaluation code.

optimizer.decode: gains = x*max|range|; margin = x+1; width = x+1; amplitude = 0.15*(x+1)

objective.definition: J = mean attack cost + mean nominal cost; see docs/milestones/M6.md

result.statement: Training: baseline survived 4/16 attacks, candidate 14/16; nominal falls 0 -> 0. Validation preview: baseline survived 0/9, candidate 8/9; nominal falls 0 -> 0. Status: candidate, pending the M7 regression gate.
